titles.title: Bol Bachchan
titles.plot: When Abbas breaks open the lock of an ancestral Hindu temple to save a child trapped inside, he faces trouble. He tries to hide his true identity with a fake Hindu name, which leads to a web of lies.

titles.title: Cat Run
titles.plot: Two bumbling detectives have to protect a high-end escort who withholds key evidence to a government cover-up from a ruthless assassin.

titles.title: Compadres
titles.plot: After his release from prison, a former Mexican lawman (Omar Chaparro) works with a teenage hacker (Joey Morgan) to find the crime boss (Erick Elías) who framed him.

titles.title: Death of Nintendo
titles.plot: Four teenage friends growing up in the 1990s Manila go on a journey of self-discovery together. They try to one-up each other's high scores and face life's obstacles, including love, peer pressure and balancing family tradition with self-identity.

titles.title: Millennium Bugs
titles.plot: Set in the days leading up to the year 2000, Kelly and Miguel find themselves facing mounting pressures and the harsh realities of their futures.

titles.title: Moonwalkers
titles.plot: In 1969 London, a CIA agent (Ron Perlman) and the manager (Rupert Grint) of a rock band must find a way to fake the moon landing.

titles.title: Pawn Shop Chronicles
titles.plot: An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.

titles.title: Stretch
titles.plot: A limo driver (Patrick Wilson) goes for the ride of his life when he shuttles a mysterious billionaire around Hollywood.

titles.title: Summer '03
titles.plot: In the midst of a family crisis, a 16-year-old girl wades through the difficult waters of her love life.

titles.title: Tere Bin Laden: Dead or Alive
titles.original_title: Tere Bin Laden: Dead or Alive
titles.plot: A U.S. agent (Sikandar Kher) hires a budding Bollywood filmmaker (Maniesh Paul) to shoot fake footage that proves the death of Osama bin Laden.

titles.plot: Three infamous brothers from Alabama stir up a lot of trouble with crooked cops, mobsters and more when they try to accomplish a single good deed.
